info.name: Pioneer DDJ-FLX10 jog screens
info.author: openDJ, from the FLX10 screen protocol worked out by Veezuhz and Loui1979
info.description: Draws each deck's waveform, time, BPM, key and tempo on the DDJ-FLX10's jog screens over USB HID. Runs beside the Pioneer DDJ-FLX10 MIDI mapping, which switches the screens over. Beta: not yet tried on the hardware.
